summary: Healthcare providers and community health workers in low-resource settings benefit from MEDPlat, a low-code platform for public healthcare. It enables the digitization of care delivery and management, improving access to essential services. MEDPlat supports the monitoring and improvement of maternal, child, and reproductive health outcomes. The platform is designed for scalability and customization, catering to various health verticals. Its offline-enabled mobile app and web interface facilitate data collection and decision-making for policymakers. By enhancing healthcare delivery, MEDPlat contributes to improved health outcomes and quality of life.
